name: NoDelay
description: Selectively removes the vanilla 4-tick right-click delay (Minecraft#rightClickDelay) with per-category control: block placement, villager trading, other entity interactions, and using items in air. Fully configurable including vanilla-like values (up to 20 ticks). Client-side only. Supports Minecraft 26.1-26.3 and 1.21-1.21.11. Localized into 14 languages.
